value.rationale: An arbitrarily small uniform first-derivative perturbation of the identity can make the new positive bounded cubic correction admit infinitely many exact nonroot periodic orbits, even though undamped Newton globally contracts on the same equations. This is a structural robustness separation in the natural numerical root-finding problem, with an explicit infinite family and asymptotic locations rather than a trivial isolated example.
